title: Rust: JWT Authentication (Simulated)
description: Simulate JWT token generation and verification in Rust.

steps.title: Base64 Encoding
steps.description: Write a function `base64_encode(data: &[u8]) -> String` that encodes bytes to base64 (using a simple implementation). Encode `"hello"` and print.
hints: Use the base64 crate or implement a simple version.

steps.title: Create JWT Header and Payload
steps.description: Create a JWT header JSON `{"alg": "HS256", "typ": "JWT"}` and payload JSON `{"sub": "123", "name": "Alice", "iat": 1516239022}`. Base64url-encode both and print the encoded parts.
hints: Base64url is base64 with `+`→`-`, `/`→`_`, no padding.

verification.failureMessage: Create and base64url-encode the JWT header and payload.

steps.title: HMAC-SHA256 Signature (Simulated)
steps.description: Implement a simple HMAC-like signature using a hash function. Create `sign(data: &str, secret: &str) -> String`. Sign the header.payload string and append the signature.
hints: Simple signature: hash data + secret (simulating HMAC).

steps.title: Verify JWT Token
steps.description: Write a `verify(token: &str, secret: &str) -> bool` function that extracts the signature, recomputes it, and checks if it matches. Test with valid and invalid tokens.
hints: Split token by `.` to get parts.
Recompute signature from header.payload and secret.
Compare computed signature with provided signature.

verification.failureMessage: Verify a valid token (true) and tampered token (false).

steps.title: Full Auth Flow
steps.description: Create a complete authentication flow: generate a token for user Alice, verify it, then simulate a protected endpoint that checks the token and returns user data.
hints: Create a function `login(username) -> String` that generates a JWT.
Create `protect(token) -> Result<User, String>` that verifies and extracts data.
This simulates how real JWT auth works in web frameworks.

verification.failureMessage: Login, get token, access protected endpoint, and print user data.
